figures.finding: St Helena has no film or performers' agreement, fund or incentive; the only pay floor is the statutory minimum wage, which rose on 1 July 2026 to £4.85 an hour for workers 18 and over (£3.83 for 16- and 17-year-olds).

statutoryMinimumWage.currency: SHP (pegged to GBP; the notice writes £)

figures.applies: St Helena; any employee, including one engaged on a film; no film-specific rule found on the government site (searched "film", "filming" 2026-11-01).

sources.said: Executive Council approved an uplift to the minimum wage at their meeting of 24 March 2026. This change will take effect from 01 July 2026 , and will raise the minimum wage as follows: for persons aged 18 yrs and over: from £4.50 to £4.85 per hour for persons aged 16 or 17 yrs : from £3.55 to £3.83 per hour
